dialog.semantics: role=dialog or alertdialog as consequence requires, aria-modal=true, programmatic labelled title and optional described consequence
dialog.initial_focus: first safe meaningful control; destructive primary is never auto-focused when a cancel/neutral target exists
dialog.background: application shell outside active modal is inert and unavailable to pointer/keyboard
dialog.focus_loop: Tab/Shift+Tab remain inside topmost modal; nested modal is prohibited except closed owned picker/popover patterns
dialog.escape: closes dismissible dialog without acceptance; non-dismissible only while owning atomic stage explicitly reports noninterruptible
dialog.close_restore: restore invoker when still present/eligible, otherwise deterministic nearest logical fallback

errors.validation: focus first invalid field after summary announcement; preserve entered safe values
errors.server_failure: keep dialog/input open unless accepted current truth makes requested edit obsolete
errors.stale: replace submit state with explicit comparison/review path; never silently retry against new revision

scroll: long content has one bounded internal scroll owner; background/sibling panes never scroll through dialog boundary
